lines.x: The Bank of Ghana's Monetary Policy Committee reduced its benchmark interest rate by 300 basis points to 11%, citing improved economic conditions and declining market interest rates.
Newmont's Ahafo South Mine celebrated two decades of commercial gold production in Ghana, backed by over $6 billion in capital investments and $3 billion in state revenue.
The Bank of Ghana reported that the cedi depreciated by 10.6% against the U.S.
Ghana's total export earnings reached a record $30.4 billion in the first ten months of 2026, driven primarily by gold shipments, according to Bank of Ghana data.
